title: Bank-only rail route does not disclose the requested card comparison gap
observation: The request explicitly names FedNow, RTP, ACH and card rails. The native output routes to bank-payment-workflow-designer, supports only regulatory applicability and economics, and gives no card-specific limitation. Its native profile registry contains bank rails only.
impact: An agent could silently drop the card leg while treating the complete comparison as routed. Lead selection itself is reasonable for the bank rails.
suggested_resolution: Retain the bank lead for the bank-leg comparison, explicitly mark card comparison as separately scoped or unsupported, and add conditional card/merchant acceptance support after the participant and card product are known.

title: Orchestration strategy silently selects a merchant lead for an unknown participant
observation: The original request does not specify merchant, issuer, bank or the orchestration layer. The selected orchestration-strategy intent unconditionally returns merchant-acceptance-strategy-designer with platform architecture as support.
impact: Merchant acceptance/PSP routing and bank/issuer hub orchestration can require different accountable leads. The agent should not treat the merchant assignment as final from this request alone.
suggested_resolution: Ask for participant and orchestration layer, or emit conditional merchant-strategy versus platform-architecture ownership; retain both as alternatives until clarified.

title: The structured missing-context list does not carry evident scope unknowns
observation: All 18 native outputs report missing_context=[] even though no jurisdiction was supplied and most participants are unknown. Some outputs list generic required_inputs and all require target validation.
impact: This does not establish target readiness or infer a supported region, but consumers could misread the empty list as complete context. The independent practitioner judgments retain the omitted scope explicitly.
suggested_resolution: Populate scope-relevant missing_context or distinguish route-selection context from target-input prerequisites; do not invent a region/role to satisfy a target.
